purpose: Make one concrete source-grounded personal cost survive into reader-visible prose through focal event ownership while keeping abstract live-vector semantics hidden.

realization_forms: preparation-to-leave behavior consistent with existing facts
brief factual thought about the already-established departure plan

audit_rules: BLOCK if desired-state/personal-cost/open-question summaries become writer-visible.
BLOCK if the focal cost carrier states abstract importance, emotional thesis or explanatory moral.
BLOCK if a new ticket, train, booking, appointment or other unsupported external deadline is invented.
BLOCK if the focal cost carrier can be omitted from prose.
BLOCK if non-focal causal ownership from Phase405 is weakened.
BLOCK if Phase404 response transaction is changed.
BLOCK if surface quotas, best-of-N, retry, A2 or second window are introduced.
